title: Zwanzig Minuten
desc: Sitting with somebody, and getting the questions wrong
setting: A hospital room with two beds, a window facing east, and a chair that somebody fetched.

steps.speaker: Rosmarie
steps.es: Du hast Blumen gekauft. Das musst du nicht.
steps.en: You bought flowers. You do not have to.

options.es: Ich habe die Zeitung auch dabei.
options.en: I have the newspaper with me too.
options.feedback: Move past it. The paper is the better present anyway and she will read it right through.
Warm, and it keeps the fuss going for another minute she does not want.
An excuse, and an invented one. She will remember it.

steps.speaker: Rosmarie
steps.es: Es hat den ganzen Tag Nebel gehabt.

options.es: Ja, unten am See war es grau.
options.en: Yes, down by the lake it was grey.
options.feedback: The weather is the vehicle, not the subject. Get in and let her drive.
She knows how she is. She is the only person in the room who knows exactly.
Twice now you have asked past what she offered you.

steps.speaker: Rosmarie
steps.es: Und? Was war bei dir heute?
steps.en: And? What happened with you today?

options.feedback: Ordinary, small, and exactly what she asked for. She wants a voice running.
That closes the only door she opened.
Kind, and it hands her the work she was trying to hand you.

steps.speaker: Rosmarie
steps.es: So. Jetzt reicht es. Diese Suppe ist ein Skandal.
steps.en: Right. That is enough now. That soup is a scandal.

options.feedback: Follow her out. That is how she ends every evening and it is how you know to go.
She will say no. Bring it on Thursday anyway.

options.es: Du hast doch vorher noch geredet.
options.feedback: She stopped on purpose. Twenty minutes is the visit.
